subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do workflow/security owners approve advancing these third-party action pins after reviewing the Codex, GitHub App-token, and Docker-publishing runtime contracts and a redacted successful run on the rebased head?
rationale: This changes external executable code at privileged CI boundaries; the repository must decide whether the updated upstream contracts are acceptable rather than treating a Dependabot pin refresh as a purely mechanical patch.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Review the upgraded action contracts and attach redacted successful runs for the rebased head before merging.

options.title: Hold the update
options.body: Keep the current pins until the owners can validate the privileged workflow paths.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge
recommendation.body: Review the upgraded action contracts and attach redacted successful runs for the rebased head before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only identifiable actor connected to the proposed update in the supplied material; a human workflow owner needs to be identified during maintainer review.
